title: Quantum Mechanics Basics
text: Quantum mechanics is the branch of physics describing the behavior of matter and energy at atomic and subatomic scales. Key principles include wave-particle duality (particles exhibit both wave and particle properties), the uncertainty principle (position and momentum cannot both be precisely known), and quantization of energy levels. Quantum mechanics underlies modern technologies including semiconductors, lasers, and MRI machines, and differs sharply from classical, deterministic physics.
